messages:
June (Marketing): Need final plan for the Compact Launch newsletter — audience splits, resend plan, and demo routing. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/compact-launch.

Arman (Growth): Proposal: primary = active trials last 21d (50%), secondary = dormant trials 22-90d (30%), product users 15%, partners 5%. Add +15% weight for engaged (opened in 60d). 3% randomized holdback. Geo-stagger across 48h.

Leah (Content): I tightened hero to one stat + 3 bullets and wrote two subject variants to test: "Compact Launch: ship LLM features faster" and "Lower latency, lower cost: meet Compact Launch". Suggest 2x2 subject/preheader matrix.

Sam (Ops): ESP safe burst = 100k/hr. I'll run a 1k seed tomorrow 09:30 PT. Suppress: global_unsub, trial_opt_out, dedicated_customers. If hard bounce >1.5% in first 30m, pause and route remainder into a 72h drip. Alerts to #deliverability.

Arman (Growth): UTMs: utm_campaign=compact_launch&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Conversion window: demo signups within 7d. Demo clicks with intent_score >= 65 -> route to #sdr-inbound; exclude AE-owned and enterprise flag.

Leah (Content): I will finalize subject + short preheaders by EOD and add an alternate subject for the 72h resend. Need confirmation on the benchmark phrasing from June.

June (Marketing): Confirmed: we can use the approved high-level stat. I'll paste exact wording in the doc by EOD. Timeline: list ready tonight, seed tomorrow 09:30 PT, main send starts Thursday 10:00 PT NA.

Sam (Ops): Action items: export suppression CSV (tonight), run seed (tomorrow AM), add monitors and burst caps. I'll post seed results here.

Arman (Growth): I'll set up the A/B allocations and winner routing tomorrow AM.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "compact-launch-newsletter". Review meeting scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

June (Marketing): Thanks — keep comments short. Ping me if anything blocks the seed run. :rocket:
